resources.string: The file may contain your recorded location and telemetry. Share it only with people you trust. Export does not change the original ride.
CSV for VESC Tool · telemetry and route
In the VESC Tool file a value is written only when it was measured. VESC Tool fills the gaps with the last known value, so a gap there looks like a steady reading.
